assumptions.assumption: Repository provisional rough boundary is used only for submission intake, concept generation and EPSG:4548 recalculation.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, figures and spatial relationships must be recalculated when an official polygon is available.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: Official Overall Design Area polygon is published or provided as a rights-cleared file.

assumptions.assumption: Repository provisional polygons locate Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin and Dazhongsi for intake discussion only.
assumptions.impact: Landmark placement, service access and area-sensitive claims require complete recomputation.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: Official Key-Area Detailed Design polygons become available.

assumptions.assumption: Official FAR, BCR, height, road redline, setbacks, heritage, greenline and engineering controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land-use bands, buildings and phasing remain conceptual and cannot support approval or construction.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: Official regulatory-plan and special-study controls are provided.

assumptions.assumption: Concept building polygons represent fourteen service-capacity carriers, not surveyed existing buildings or proposed construction quantities.
assumptions.impact: No parcel, acquisition, demolition, floor-area or investment conclusion may be drawn.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: Verified building, ownership, use, structure, fire and heritage surveys are completed.

assumptions.assumption: The Life Corridor and seven cross-links express desired relationships, not road redlines, transport capacity or engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: The 17.56 km figure is a concept-line length only; road area and the 8/80 pass rate remain unknown.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: Official road, transit, crossing, topography, accessibility and pedestrian-flow data are available.

assumptions.assumption: Seven circles are schematic service units. They are not network isochrones and do not prove that every service is reachable in fifteen minutes.
assumptions.impact: The seven-circle count is known as a design construct, while actual service coverage requires routing and field audits.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: A verified pedestrian network, service inventory, opening hours and barrier survey are available.

assumptions.assumption: Operators, budgets, policies, activities and Public-Benefit Contracts are proposal mechanisms, not confirmed government or partner commitments.
assumptions.impact: No landmark or smart facility may proceed without named responsibility, a ten-year operating budget, maintenance and exit terms.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: Government, community, professional and enterprise partners approve an operating agreement.

assumptions.assumption: Official public sources establish a Beixiaguan headquarters project entry and a volunteer-teaching connection at the Dazhongsi AI night school; they do not establish endorsement of this proposal.
assumptions.impact: The Dazhongsi role is a public-value concept. It uses no corporate logo, private data, land-control claim or partnership promise.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: A directly relevant current corporate or government planning document is officially released.

assumptions.assumption: The six rights are participant-defined design safeguards and service requirements, not a claim that a specific law already mandates this exact list.
assumptions.impact: They must be translated into procurement, interface, staffing, appeal and shutdown clauses before implementation.
assumptions.trigger_for_revision: Applicable laws, standards or approved service rules impose stronger safeguards.
